about: Named 3D subjects and library models. fyt/assets.py identifies the exact object a world scene shows and resolves it here: a library model (a vetted glTF in renderer/public/models, with its licence) first, then a spec (published features that drive the procedural module), else the module's generic model. Specs give structure only, never a real company's livery or logo.

titanic.subject: ship
titanic.title: RMS Titanic
titanic.notes: Four buff funnels with black tops (the fourth a dummy), black hull over red boot topping, white superstructure, two masts. Proportions simplified.

olympic.subject: ship
olympic.title: RMS Olympic
olympic.notes: Titanic's near-identical sister: four buff funnels with black tops, black hull, two masts. Proportions simplified.

lusitania.subject: ship
lusitania.title: RMS Lusitania
lusitania.notes: Four red funnels with black tops, black hull, white superstructure, two masts. Proportions simplified.

queen-mary.subject: ship
queen-mary.title: RMS Queen Mary
queen-mary.notes: Three red funnels with black tops, black hull, white superstructure, two masts. Proportions simplified.

boeing-747.subject: aircraft
boeing-747.title: Boeing 747
boeing-747.notes: Four underwing engines and the upper-deck hump over the forward fuselage. Length shortened to frame.

airbus-a380.subject: aircraft
airbus-a380.title: Airbus A380
airbus-a380.notes: Four underwing engines and a full-length double-deck fuselage. Length shortened to frame.

boeing-737.subject: aircraft
boeing-737.title: Boeing 737
boeing-737.notes: A narrow-body twinjet with two underwing engines. Proportions simplified.

airbus-a320.subject: aircraft
airbus-a320.title: Airbus A320
airbus-a320.notes: A narrow-body twinjet with two underwing engines. Proportions simplified.

boeing-777.subject: aircraft
boeing-777.title: Boeing 777
boeing-777.notes: A wide-body twinjet with two very large underwing engines. Length shortened to frame.

saturn-v.subject: rocket
saturn-v.title: Saturn V
saturn-v.notes: Three stages, white with the black roll pattern on the first stage, four fins, and the launch escape tower on top. Proportions simplified.

falcon-9.subject: rocket
falcon-9.title: Falcon 9
falcon-9.notes: Two stages, white, with a black interstage and no fins. Proportions simplified.

space-shuttle.subject: rocket
space-shuttle.title: Space Shuttle
space-shuttle.notes: Orbiter, orange external tank and two white boosters. Proportions simplified.
